thesis: The page is the monitoring log: every section is a row in the station record, and the signature is the numbered station ring that lights up as the log fills in.

signature.name: Station Ring + Log Row
signature.summary: Top-down house footprint with 12 numbered station dots (BR-01–BR-12) in a ring; log rows (DATE · STATION · ACTIVITY · ACTION) type in on scroll. Ring lights stations in groups during stories; reviews carry station pills; footer resets to all lit. Hook: data-sw-signature='station-ring'.

palette.family: Bayou Green + Log Bone + Cypress Teal

motion.intro: Diagonal treated-zone line draws corner-to-corner ≤1.2s, then 12 station dots rise in stagger; skippable.
stories: dial: station ring lights in groups as liquid-vs-bait story scrolls
count: plan cost total counts up from tool inputs
motion.hover: Station dot scales 1.15× and log-row underline grows from left via scaleX
